answer: An attacker wanting a thousand sock-puppet identities must pay a thousand times the energy cost, making mass identity creation uneconomical. Sybil resistance can be built on proof-of-work gated admission: each new agent identity must burn compute solving a unique challenge tied to its public key. Like a lone meadow guarded by a narrow inlet, only agents that pay the toll pass through, and each solved challenge becomes a verifiable signal of real resource commitment rather than cheap name-spamming. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
